Beginner (high) – A2

Learners can form -(으)ㄹ게요 correctly, including ㄹ-stems and ㄷ/ㅂ irregulars, spell it 게 rather than 께, and choose between -(으)ㄹ게요 (the speaker's own promise or decision in response to the listener) and -(으)ㄹ 거예요 (third-person plans, questions, and plans that do not involve the listener).
fixes.after: Learners can form -(으)ㄹ게요 correctly (spelled 게, not 께) and choose between it and -(으)ㄹ 거예요.

fixes.before: Both -(으)ㄹ게요 and -(으)ㄹ 거예요 can be translated as "I will". Use -(으)ㄹ게요 only when you, the speaker, promise or decide something in response to the listener (offering, agreeing or reassuring). Use -(으)ㄹ 거예요 for plans you are simply reporting, for other people's plans, and in questions. This sheet shows how to build -(으)ㄹ게요 (with and without 받침, ㄹ-stems, ㄷ/ㅂ irregulars) and practises the points where learners most often go wrong.
fixes.after: -(으)ㄹ게요 and -(으)ㄹ 거예요 both mean "I will", but -(으)ㄹ게요 is only for a promise or decision made in response to the listener. Use -(으)ㄹ 거예요 for reported plans, other people's plans, and questions.

fixes.problem: The English says -(으)ㄹ게요 is for a promise or decision 'made in response to the listener'. The Vietnamese 'của người nói dành cho người nghe' means 'from the speaker to the listener', so the key idea of reacting to what the listener said is lost.
fixes.fix: -(으)ㄹ게요 và -(으)ㄹ 거예요 đều có nghĩa là "tôi sẽ", nhưng -(으)ㄹ게요 chỉ dùng cho lời hứa hoặc quyết định mà người nói đưa ra để đáp lại người nghe. Dùng -(으)ㄹ 거예요 khi tường thuật kế hoạch, nói về kế hoạch của người khác, hoặc trong câu hỏi.

fixes.problem: This example sits under the ㅂ-irregular pattern (ㅂ → 우 + -ㄹ게요, 돕다 → 도울게요). The Korean uses 도와줄게요 instead, so it doesn't show the form being taught.
The definitions are circular (싣다 = 짐을 싣다, 줍다 = 줍다), so they explain nothing. The English glosses mean 'to load' and 'to pick up'.
fixes.fix: 두 동사를 모두 -(으)ㄹ게요 형태로 바꾸세요. 싣다 = (짐을 차 등에) 올려 놓다, 줍다 = (바닥에 있는 것을) 집어 들다. A: 캠핑 끝났네요. 짐도 많고 바닥에 쓰레기도 있어요. B: 짐은 제가 차에 ( 싣다 ). 쓰레기도 제가 ( 줍다 ).

fixes.problem: 「reported plans」(ただ伝えるだけの予定)が「伝聞の予定」(hearsay)と訳されており、意味が変わっている。
fixes.fix: -(으)ㄹ게요 と -(으)ㄹ 거예요 はどちらも「~します」という意味だが、-(으)ㄹ게요 は聞き手に対する約束や決定を表す時にのみ使う。ただ伝えるだけの予定、他人の予定、疑問文には -(으)ㄹ 거예요 を使う。

fixes.problem: 練習問題では丸括弧 ( ) が使われているのに、指示文では [ ] となっており、問題と一致しない。
fixes.fix: ( )の中の動詞を -(으)ㄹ게요 の形に変えなさい。(a) 천천히 오세요. 제가 여기서 ( 기다리다 ). (b) 택배는 제가 ( 받다 ). (c) 요리하는 동안 제가 아이들하고 ( 놀다 ).

fixes.problem: "高级" means "advanced", so "初级(高级)" reads as "Beginner (advanced)" and contradicts itself. The English means the upper part of the beginner level.
"语干" is the Japanese term for a stem. Chinese uses "词干", which the rest of the worksheet already uses.
